method: BLINDED. Each card showed LINZ Basemaps aerial imagery at zoom 18 (400 px, and zoom 20 at 660-720 px for any card the reviewer could not settle at zoom 18), both AMDS centrelines (link A red, link B cyan), the crossing point in yellow, a card code, the two link ids and the two road names. The classifier's disposition and deciding rule were NOT shown: they live in answer-key.json and were joined only after every verdict below was written. Card order was randomised across strata with seed 'at-grade-holdout-2026-08-18'.
independence: Drawn from the national record EXCLUDING every link pair in the 208-card development pack and the earlier unblinded pack, and every crossing within 50 m of one of those. 288 pairs and a further 152 near neighbours were removed before the draw. The 208-card pack is DEVELOPMENT data: both surviving classifier fixes were derived from it.
reviewer: single reviewer (the model), one pass. NOT independent human ground truth: it is a model-assisted visual review, blinded to the classifier's answer but not a separate party from the code. Pass 2 in holdout-verdicts-recode.json double-codes a subset to measure consistency; that measures reliability, not validity.
